author: Tynvale
body:
I think that this would be a good idea becuase for the people that don't play as much, but still want to get things like badges. They can buy credits, in my personal opinion I would rather pay $20 then spend months trying to get enough credits for a badge! I also think that this has the possibility to generate some money towards making Avicus a better server, even though it's already the best :D

What is your opinion on this?

replies.author: Jahaj
replies.body:
Yes it is:

My server features a currency that you can earn through gameplay, but which can also be bought for hard currency. Is that OK?
Soft currencies that are earned in-game are fine, but you cannot sell in-game currency for hard currency. Hybrid/dual currency systems are not allowed.

Here is the link: https://mojang.com/2014/06/lets-talk-server-monetisation-the-follow-up-qa/
In Game Currency = Credits

replies.body:
You should clarify that better in your OP because they're completely different suggestions.
You also fail to make any mention of your second suggestion at all in your OP.

I sugest next time you alter your main suggestion that you also change your OP and title so that people aren't confused.

Now, to the topic.

Your first suggestion I'm not a fan of.
Although it's not pay to win in a sense. (You don't gain any real advantage over people)
It's still a very cheap way to obtain credits. 

I don't think this would be implemented any time soon.
It also seems to be something that the majority of the community doesn't like.

Your second suggestion however, I quite like.
I think rewarding players with credits as apart of official community parties that are occasionally hosted would be a cool idea. It could be implemented next to the Emerald rank giveaway.
